description: This file defines models and a fetcher for WSJ Asset Performance Active data, including data validation, query parameter handling, data extraction from WSJ API, and data transformation.

classes.name: WSJActiveQueryParams
classes.description: Class for handling query parameters specific to WSJ active asset performance.

classes.name: WSJActiveData
classes.description: Data model representing WSJ active asset performance data with validation and field aliases.

classes.name: WSJActiveFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to retrieve, transform, and validate WSJ active asset data from the WSJ API.

methods.name: date_validate
methods.description: Validates and converts date string to date object.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a WSJActiveQueryParams instance.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches data from WSJ API endpoint and returns instrument data.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into list of WSJActiveData instances, sorted by volume.
